title: New Every Morning
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who sits still long enough to notice a quiet truth, and tonight the writer of Lamentations does exactly that: he sits in the quiet of a ruined city and remembers that Heavenly Father’s mercies are new every morning, the same way Wren learned at breakfast that His kindness never runs out.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she sits still long enough to notice a quiet truth. In Wren’s world today: she spills her juice at breakfast, and the awful feeling stays all morning. At bedtime, Mom says tomorrow will be a brand-new day. Just like the writer of Lamentations remembering that Heavenly Father’s mercies are new every morning, Wren learned that His kindness never runs out.
